name: variousforks-mattpocock-skills
description: Greg's fork of Matt Pocock / AI Hero's agent-skills collection, with skills exposed as individually-installable Claude Code plugins. The pristine upstream is at mattpocock/skills.

plugins.name: aihero-tdd
plugins.description: Test-driven development with a red-green-refactor loop. Builds features or fixes bugs one vertical slice at a time.

plugins.name: aihero-write-a-prd
plugins.description: Create a PRD through an interactive interview, codebase exploration, and module design. Filed as a GitHub issue.

plugins.name: aihero-prd-to-plan
plugins.description: Turn a PRD into a multi-phase implementation plan using tracer-bullet vertical slices, saved as a local Markdown file in `./plans/`.

plugins.name: aihero-prd-to-issues
plugins.description: Break a PRD into independently-grabbable GitHub issues using vertical slices.

plugins.name: aihero-grill-me
plugins.description: Get relentlessly interviewed about a plan or design until every branch of the decision tree is resolved.

plugins.name: aihero-git-guardrails-claude-code
plugins.description: Set up Claude Code hooks to block dangerous git commands (push, reset --hard, clean, etc.) before they execute.

plugins.name: aihero-improve-codebase-architecture
plugins.description: Explore a codebase for architectural improvement opportunities, focusing on deepening shallow modules and improving testability.

plugins.name: aihero-triage-issue
plugins.description: Investigate a bug by exploring the codebase, identify the root cause, and file a GitHub issue with a TDD-based fix plan.
